summary: Tested admin extended endpoints (users update + client CRUD) plus regression suites. Backend 21/21 tests pass (6 new admin_extended + 12 rides + 3 password_reset). Frontend smoke: login as admin/admin works, navigation to Admin tab via the top page-dropdown (labelled by current tab e.g. 'Calle' -> 'Admin') works, 'Gestionar Clientes' toggle button (data-testid=admin-toggle-clients) opens the AdminClients panel (admin-clients-panel) rendering 20 existing clients, '+ Nuevo cliente' opens modal with all expected form testIDs (admin-client-form-phone/first-name/last-name/email/password/submit) and the phone label indicates 'Telefono (E.164)' hint. AdminUserEditModal component is imported and mounted at index.tsx line ~21520 with the expected internal testIDs (admin-user-edit-role-*, admin-user-edit-shift-*, admin-user-edit-add-licencia, admin-user-edit-save). NOT verified opening the modal end-to-end because the pencil edit button in the users list has NO data-testid, which blocks reliable Playwright automation.

ui_bugs.issue: The blue pencil TouchableOpacity (styles.editUserButton) at /app/frontend/app/index.tsx ~line 17550 has no data-testid. The trash button (styles.deleteUserButton) also lacks one. Requested by test spec but missing — Playwright cannot reliably open the AdminUserEditModal to verify the flow.

action_items: Add data-testid="admin-user-edit-btn-{user.id}" (or fixed testID admin-user-edit-btn) on the pencil TouchableOpacity in the Users List (~line 17550 of /app/frontend/app/index.tsx) so the AdminUserEditModal flow can be automated.
Also add data-testid to the trash TouchableOpacity next to it for parity.
Optional: add data-testid to LoginForm username/password inputs (still missing from previous iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: The users list only renders when adminSearchQuery is empty AND showUsersList is true (line 17515). When admin types a query, the users list is hidden but no separate 'search results' UI appears in that branch — users may think search is broken. Consider showing search results inline or clearing the 'Ver Todos' state when a query is present.
index.tsx is now >21500 lines and getting harder to review each iteration. Please split into feature modules.
